ImageDescription.value: This photo shows a street food stall or small restaurant in what appears to be Thailand, based on the Thai script visible on the signage. The setup includes a simple outdoor cooking area with several blue plastic containers or barrels, stainless steel preparation surfaces, and some cooking equipment. The stall has a colorful banner with Thai writing, and there are people working at the stall. In the background, there's a colorful scooter or motorcycle parked nearby, with blue and yellow/orange coloring. The scene represents a typical street food operation in Southeast Asia, where vendors prepare and sell food directly on the sidewalk or roadside. There's also what looks like a white umbrella or canopy visible on the right side of the image, likely providing shade for another vendor or customers. This type of informal street food setup is very common in Thailand and throughout Southeast Asia, forming an important part of the local food culture and economy.

ObjectName.value: India - Chennai - Stainless Steel shops - 03 (3016006648)

Categories.value: Taken with Canon PowerShot S5 IS|Containers|Flickr images reviewed by File Upload Bot (Magnus Manske)|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation|Shops in Chennai|Photographs of India by McKay Savage

ImageDescription.value:
A wall of stacked tiffen boxes. Every Indian needs a tiffen box for lunches, a neat stack of small containers of hot food - typically in South India to be rice, a curry, dhal or sambar, and curd.

With an eye for shiny objects, one of my favorite shops in Chennai is the stainless steel shops of T. Nagar. Like grottoes of gleaming treasure, these shops solely sell implements of shiny steel (how's that for alliteration!). Stacked neatly - or more often haphazardly - from floor to ceiling one is fully immersed among piles of reflective and sometimes bewildering stuff - pots, dishes, plates, spoons, jars and containers of every shape and size.

Credit.value: India - Chennai - Stainless Steel shops - 03

Artist.value: McKay Savage from London, UK
